description.value:
You discharge a spray of fire-suppressing foam into a 5-foot cube at a point within range. Any flames there are instantly snuffed out, and objects in the area resist ignition for at least a minute. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d4 cold damage.

At 5th level, you can instead target a 10-foot cube; the area increases further at 11th level (15-foot cube) and 17th level (20-foot cube).

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
